macro.target: US CPI seasonally adjusted YoY, percentage points
macro.target_policy: Current revised CPI ratio for target month and year-earlier period; availability is ASSUMED at period start +45 days. This single-snapshot pseudo-release panel does not establish first-release targets.
macro.information_policy: CURRENT revised snapshot; ASSUMED lags CPI=45 calendar days from month start, oil=5 days. NOT a real-time backtest.

provenance.provenance: cached current revised FRED snapshot; assumed availability lags; no new download

uncertainty_policy.loss_difference: Paired circular moving-block percentile 95% interval, 1000 replicates; negative means lower MAE than persistence.
uncertainty_policy.prediction_intervals: 90% empirical absolute-error bands from up to 60 past OOS residuals whose targets were already released; minimum 24, up to 36 warm-up origins.
uncertainty_policy.caution: Time dependence and changing regimes invalidate a distribution-free coverage guarantee. Block results are exploratory, block-length dependent and unadjusted for model multiplicity.

limitations: Fixed hyperparameters; no tuning on evaluation origins
Overlapping horizons, nonstationarity and missing origin months remain; bootstrap blocks use available forecast order
Coverage is first-seen archive coverage, not independently verified release history
Daily vintage dates do not establish intraday release times
Retrospective final-vintage outcomes are diagnostic only; never training labels
Revision leakage remains despite assumed release lags

protocol.observation_time_unit: one synthetic observation-step; no wall-clock frequency inference
protocol.episode_rule: consecutive alerts separated by at most merge_gap unflagged observations form one episode; one new episode can match one event at/after onset within max_detection_delay
protocol.parameter_selection: Fixed reference design; no threshold or model tuning on held-out paths; not independent preregistration

calibration.rule: absolute score > upper calibration quantile; higher interpolation; no test refit

historical_review.interpretation: Post-hoc high-score examples in selected years, not independently labelled shocks. V2 coverage uses 60 observations; synthetic thresholds are not validated for transfer to these instruments/frequencies.

limitations: Known inserted synthetic jumps are the only ground truth; heavy-tailed natural innovations are nuisance events under this definition, not verified false economic shocks
Same pooled clean calibration alert budget does not guarantee equal false-alert rates under held-out regimes or real markets
Episode matching permits chance alarms within the fixed delay tolerance; delay statistics condition on detected events and exclude misses
Observations within paths and paired clean/jump paths are dependent; no significance claim or independent economic accuracy estimate
Fixed 5% return threshold is diagnostic only and must not be presented as a fair budget-matched competitor
Synthetic thresholds are research outputs and are not deployed into the V1 analyst alerts

strict_macro: No real FRED API key supplied; unverified CSV cannot claim strict provenance
live_market: Persistent adapter implemented; not exercised against an entitled provider account
ci: Configured; not run on GitHub before publication
